Score labels against vendor-delivered ASPRS classes

Source: R/classify.R
evaluate_vendor_classes.Rd

Some 3DEP deliveries classify vegetation (ASPRS 3-5) and buildings (6). Those vendor classes are independent of this package's weak labels, so they provide a ground-truth check for the classes they cover. Only points whose vendor class is in map are scored; vendor "unclassified" points are excluded. Vegetation usually dominates (prevalence near 1), so its F1 cannot show skill: an always-"vegetation" baseline is reported alongside, with balanced accuracy and Cohen's kappa over the mapped classes. A class that is never predicted has precision 0, not NA.

Usage

evaluate_vendor_classes(
  labels,
  vendor_class,
  map = list(vegetation = 3:5, building = 6L)
)

Arguments

labels

Factor of labels to score (e.g. pred$pred or feat$label).

vendor_class

Integer ASPRS class of the same points.

map

Named list mapping package labels to vendor class codes.

Value

A list with metrics (per-class precision, recall, F1, n, plus balanced_accuracy and kappa), baseline (the same for predicting the majority class everywhere) and confusion.
